channel.title: Business News
channel.description: Latest headlines for business news around the world.

item.title: Microdrama apps chase profits as Hollywood moves into short-form, vertical video
item.description: The microdrama category has exploded at a time when traditional forms of media face waning interest and YouTube claims more viewing hours.

item.title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather
item.description: Macy's announced Wednesday that its annual Thanksgiving Day Parade is being postponed to Saturday due to severe weather.

item.title: Secondhand shopping is going mainstream this holiday season as consumers seek value
item.description: More consumers are shopping secondhand this holiday season as they emphasize value and uniqueness in their purchases.

item.title: Retail turnarounds are taking hold just in time for the holiday season
item.description: Retail earnings reports on Tuesday pointed to a mix of factors behind the strong results, including a resilient consumer and stronger execution.

item.title: Best Buy reports comparable sales growth of 6.1%, highest in five years
item.description: Best Buy beat quarterly expectations for its fiscal third-quarter earnings results on Tuesday and raised its full-year guidance.

item.title: Some U.S. food banks see demand top pandemic levels
item.description: A combination of high costs and restrictions to federal aid have led to soaring demand at many food banks in the U.S.

item.title: ESPN, NFL to show Super Bowl 61 in Imax theaters
item.description: In addition to ESPN channels, Super Bowl 61 will also be available on streaming platform Disney+ as well as the company's broadcast network ABC.

item.title: Employees at Eric Trump-backed robot startup lose health benefits as company's cash crunch deepens
item.description: Foundation is pursuing an emergency bridge loan and has been in talks with VC firms as it waits for a $150 million investment from South Korea's Base Group.

item.title: International first class is over for U.S. airlines. Enter the mega business-class cabin
item.description: Airlines are opting to build giant business-class cabins with ever-more luxurious suites.

item.title: Pizza chains are under pressure. GLP-1 use is only one part of the problem
item.description: Domino's, Papa Johns and Pizza Hut face weaker demand, more delivery competition and changing eating habits, including GLP-1 use.

item.title: Ex-GM CEO on Mary Barra succession planning: 'It's going to be tough'
item.description: Former GM CEO Dan Akerson says whoever replaces Mary Barra will have a difficult task because they'll inherit rapid change in technology and the auto industry.

item.title: Rejecting cheap fabrics, higher prices: Why shoppers are asking for better clothes
item.description: Retailers are charging higher prices for clothing made with cheaper materials. Shoppers are taking notice and experts say it could shift how they spend.

item.title: A24 is having a great year at the box office. That could give HBO Max a streaming edge
item.description: A24 films "Backrooms," "The Drama" and the Elizabeth Holmes documentary, "You Can See Everything," are fueling a banner year at the box office.

item.title: Gap names new Athleta CEO, says Old Navy turnaround is seeing signs of progress
item.description: Gap on Thursday announced Ashley Kechter as the new CEO of Athleta. The retailer also reported mixed fiscal third-quarter earnings.

item.title: Walmart hikes outlook as CEO tells CNBC retailer aims to keep prices low despite soaring fuel costs
item.description: Walmart said it saw strength with store-fulfilled pickup and delivery in its fiscal third quarter.

item.title: Investigators make progress in hunt for cause of FAA ground stop
item.description: Engineers and analysts are still searching for the root cause of the issue, which led to a four-hour ground stop on Friday.

item.title: Ford starts U.S. battery cell production using Chinese tech amid geopolitical tensions
item.description: Ford has started U.S. production and shipments of battery cells for its next-generation EVs using technologies licensed by Chinese battery giant CATL.

item.title: Hims & Hers launches new peptide treatments — while admitting there's more to learn about efficacy
item.description: The telehealth company will now offer compounded forms of sermorelin, glutathione, NAD+, vitamin B-12 and L-carnitine, none of which are approved by the FDA.

item.title: Target shares rise 7% as retailer posts best sales growth in five years, hikes guidance
item.description: Target beat third-quarter sales expectations and raised its guidance as it continues a turnaround effort.

item.title: Lowe's posts strong online sales, raises outlook despite slow housing market
item.description: Lowe's said it saw strength in online sales during its quarter that contributed to a guidance raise for the full year.

item.title: Booking Holdings creates new enterprise division as AI reshapes travel planning
item.description: The future for online travel agencies increasingly relies on scaling business-to-business travel platforms.

item.title: FAA pauses installation of new routers after ground stop
item.description: Problems with the overwhelmed technology led the agency to issue a rare nationwide ground stop on Friday.

item.title: U.S. officially loses measles elimination status amid ongoing outbreaks
item.description: The director of PAHO made the final call that measles is endemic — or always present — in the U.S. following 12 months of continuous transmission.

item.title: Republicans outspent Democrats for first time in over a decade in record 2026 midterm election political ad blitz
item.description: Republicans slightly outspent Democrats for the first time as Democrats swept national and state elections.

item.title: Nike lays out financial goals ahead of first investor day in 9 years
item.description: Nike is hosting an investor day at its Oregon headquarters as the company tries to prove to investors that its turnaround is working.

item.title: Home Depot names Richard McPhail as new CEO, beats earnings expectations
item.description: Home Depot named Richard McPhail as its new CEO effective next week.

item.title: Disney beats fourth-quarter estimates, targets $3 billion in savings through cost-cutting efforts
item.description: Investors will be looking for more insight into CEO Josh D'Amaro's strategy following several rounds of layoffs.

item.title: United Airlines resolves system outage that affected departing flights
item.description: The airline said there was no impact on flights in progress and there was no indication the outage was a cyberattack.

item.title: JPMorgan Chase says temporary software bug is affecting consumer banking
item.description: CNBC's Eamon Javers reported there was no indication of bad actors involved and likewise no indication that a bug was impacting multiple banks at the same time.

item.title: Robert Pattinson cast as next James Bond
item.description: Pattinson has been in major films this year, including Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey," and will soon appear in "Dune: Part Three."
